create.name: Dr. Jennifer Freed
create.bio:
Based in Santa Barbara, California, Dr. Jennifer Freed works as a psychological astrologer, writer and retreat leader. She holds a doctorate in psychology and is a licensed marriage and family therapist, and for more than twenty-five years she has brought that clinical background together with astrology in her work with individuals and groups. She co-founded the nonprofit AHA!, and her books include Use Your Planets Wisely, A Map to Your Soul, an astrology oracle deck and an astrology-themed novel, Beyond Aquarius.

She pushes back against astrology as a fixed script, treating the birth chart instead as a picture of a person's gifts, tensions and ways of relating, read side by side with their own life story. She meets clients one to one in Santa Barbara and online, holds group circles, and leads retreats in and around Montecito as well as further afield, including a gathering in Bali. Her writing on astrology, ageing and friendship has appeared in places such as goop and TODAY, and she keeps up a regular Substack newsletter.

books.title: Use Your Planets Wisely: Master Your Cosmic DNA and Grow into Your Highest Potential
books.author: Jennifer Freed
books.description: Her introduction to psychological astrology, published by Sounds True. It goes well beyond sun signs, showing how the whole birth chart can be read as a map of strengths, shadows and relationships.

books.title: A Map to Your Soul: Using the Astrology of Fire, Earth, Air, and Water to Live Deeply and Fully
books.author: Jennifer Freed
books.description: A guide organised around the four elements of astrology. Readers work out their own balance of fire, earth, air and water and are given practices for strengthening what is missing.

books.title: Astrology Oracle
books.author: Jennifer Freed
books.description: A card deck from Llewellyn for daily guidance drawn from astrological symbols. It is listed in the decks section of her shop.

courses.title: Psychological Astrology Coaching Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions in Santa Barbara or online that read the birth chart alongside personal history. They focus on emotional patterns, relationships, life changes and a sense of purpose; booked through her assistant by email.

courses.title: Transforming Tools: A Journey into Your Highest Potential
courses.description: A thirty-week programme that opens with a weekend in Montecito, California, led by her with a group of guest teachers. It covers emotional skill, spiritual intelligence, connection with others and how to help others grow.
